name: B10-0303/2025 (The Left) – The human cost of Russia’s war against Ukraine and the urgent need to end Russian aggression: the situation of illegally detained civilians and prisoners of war, and the continued bombing of civilians
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human cost of Russia’s war against Ukraine and the urgent need to end Russian aggression: the situation of illegally detained civilians and prisoners of war, and the continued bombing of civilians
part_text:
This resolution is an opinion. It does not change any law. It condemns Russia's war on Ukraine and calls for the release of detained Ukrainian civilians and prisoners of war. It asks Russia to stop attacking civilians and to let aid groups visit detainees. It also criticises the European Union for not sanctioning Israel over the war in Gaza, and it opposes more military spending.

- Nothing changes yet; it is a statement of the Parliament's position.
- It targets Russia, Ukraine, Israel and European Union leaders.
- It will be sent to governments and institutions; no action is required.
